title: Sensational Soccer
summary: Scrolling six-a-side football with world-tour teams, keeper AI, animated stadium and network play.
description: An original touchline-camera football game on a 960-pixel scrolling pitch: six-a-side teams from Napoli, London, Tokyo and Rio, mirrored animated sprites with run, kick, slide and celebration frames, diving goalkeepers, ball height, spin and aftertouch, passing, slide tackles, corners, goal kicks and throw-ins, a parallax floodlit stadium with an animated crowd and scrolling advertising boards, a three-round world tour, network opposition, and a self-playing attract mode. Music plays only on the title and result screens; matches use stereo event effects (kicks, touches, whistle, crowd roar, post, net) only.
controls: Stick: move or aftertouch; A: shoot, or slide tackle without the ball; B: pass, or switch player without the ball; SELECT: back to title
